# AgriShield — Technical Report

*Reliability-Aware Plant Disease Detection Under Image Quality Degradation.* Generated by `scripts/make_report.py` from
`reports/metrics/`. Seed 42. Every number below is read from those files.

## 1. Problem statement
Plant-disease classifiers trained on curated photos can be wrong without warning when an image is dark, blurred, noisy, compressed
or low-resolution. We measure how much these degradations hurt an EfficientNet-B0 classifier, and test whether a Random Forest
can flag likely-incorrect predictions better than simple confidence or margin thresholds.

## 2. Proposed contribution
An engineering and evaluation study, not a new algorithm:
- a leakage-aware pipeline with separate train / validation / calibration / test partitions;
- a controlled degradation benchmark (6 corruption types × 3 severities);
- a learned error detector (Random Forest) with two deployable feature sets, compared with confidence and margin baselines on
  the same locked test set;
- an external check on PlantDoc.

No literature review was carried out for this deliverable, so **no novelty is claimed**.

## 3. Dataset
**PlantVillage** (https://github.com/spMohanty/PlantVillage-Dataset (raw/color)): 54,305 files, 38 classes, 0 unreadable.
Class sizes are imbalanced, with the largest class 36.2× the smallest. The most common image size
is 256x256.

**Duplicates.** 21 exact-duplicate pairs (MD5) and 71
near-duplicate pairs (dHash ≤ 4 bits) were found. They form 509 multi-image groups.
0 images whose duplicates carried a different label were excluded.

**Split.** group-level stratified split by class; groups = exact copies (md5), confirmed near-duplicates (dHash <= 4 bits AND thumbnail MAE <= 8) and photos of the same leaf (same class + source id). Seed 42. Sizes: train 38,014, val 5,433, test 5,432, calibration 5,426.
The calibration images are divided by group into rel_train 3,801, rel_val 1,625.
Manifests: `reports/manifests/`.

**PlantDoc** (https://github.com/pratikkayal/PlantDoc-Dataset (TRAIN + TEST folders; never trained on)): 2,572 files, 28 classes. Mapping status:
exact 2,234, ambiguous 338. Files byte-identical to PlantVillage:
0. The label mapping is in `src/external_mapping.py`.

## 4. Methodology
1. Duplicate-aware, class-stratified group split. The test set is locked.
2. Fine-tune EfficientNet-B0 on **train**. Select the epoch with the best **validation** macro-F1.
3. Run the frozen classifier on **calibration** and **test** images, each under 19 conditions (clean + 18 corruptions).
4. Fit the Random Forest on **rel_train**. Choose its hyper-parameters (PR-AUC) and every threshold (max F2) on **rel_val**.
5. Evaluate once on **test**, then on PlantDoc.

## 5. Model architecture
- **Classifier:** torchvision EfficientNet-B0, ImageNet-initialised, with the final layer replaced by Linear(1280, 38).
  It has 4,056,226 parameters, a 16.5 MB checkpoint and single-image latency
  cpu 258.5 ms, mps 15.3 ms.
- **Training:** AdamW (lr 0.0003), cosine schedule, batch 32,
  class-weighted cross-entropy (1/√frequency), mild augmentation (crop, flip, ±15° rotation, slight colour jitter).
  Training ran for 6 epochs and the best epoch was 6, on device mps.
- **Reliability:** scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier with class_weight="balanced_subsample".
  Selected hyper-parameters: A `{"n_estimators": 400, "max_depth": null, "min_samples_leaf": 5, "max_features": 0.5}`, B `{"n_estimators": 400, "max_depth": null, "min_samples_leaf": 1, "max_features": "sqrt"}`.

## 6. Reliability target and features
Target: **1 = the disease prediction is incorrect**, 0 = correct. The ground truth is used only to build this target.
- **Configuration A** (11 features), computed from the uploaded image alone:
  max_prob, margin_top1_top2, entropy_norm, top3_mass, brightness, contrast, sharpness_log_lapvar, noise_sigma, saturation, original_min_side, aspect_ratio.
- **Configuration B** adds stability under a fixed policy of 6 mild perturbations
  (+6 forward passes per image, applied identically in training and in the app):
  stability_agree_frac, stability_mean_pred_prob, stability_min_pred_prob, stability_std_pred_prob, stability_mean_l1_shift, stability_n_distinct.

## 7. Experimental setup
Corruptions are applied to the 256-px image before preprocessing: {"brightness_low": [0.7, 0.5, 0.3], "brightness_high": [1.3, 1.6, 2.0], "gaussian_blur": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0], "gaussian_noise": [0.05, 0.1, 0.2], "jpeg_compression": [30, 15, 5], "low_resolution": [0.5, 0.25, 0.125]}. Test rows: 21,728
(5,432 images × 4 conditions). Validation-selected thresholds:
RF-A 0.2773, RF-B 0.1175.

|---|---|
| Test images | 5,432 |
| Accuracy | 99.80% |
| Macro precision | 0.9966 |
| Macro recall | 0.9957 |
| Macro F1 | 0.9961 |

### 8.3 Reliability (positive = incorrect; all 21,728 test rows)
| method               | precision   | recall   | f1     |   roc_auc |   pr_auc | false_negative_rate   | false_alarm_rate   | flagged_share   |   aurc |
|:---------------------|:------------|:---------|:-------|----------:|---------:|:----------------------|:-------------------|:----------------|-------:|
| Confidence threshold | 57.69%      | 95.73%   | 72.00% |    0.9624 |   0.8483 | 4.27%                 | 15.31%             | 29.71%          | 0.0241 |
| Margin threshold     | 56.88%      | 95.94%   | 71.42% |    0.9588 |   0.8091 | 4.06%                 | 15.86%             | 30.20%          | 0.0247 |
| Random Forest (A)    | 63.71%      | 94.99%   | 76.26% |    0.9719 |   0.8857 | 5.01%                 | 11.80%             | 26.69%          | 0.0223 |
| Random Forest (B)    | 66.68%      | 97.40%   | 79.17% |    0.986  |   0.9468 | 2.60%                 | 10.61%             | 26.15%          | 0.0198 |

On **clean images only**, RF-B scored precision 19.57%, recall 81.82% and PR-AUC
0.3198, on 5,432 rows of which 0.20% were incorrect.

Clean-only comparison (all methods, same 5,432 rows): Confidence threshold PR-AUC 0.414, recall 81.82%, false alarms 1.03%; Margin threshold PR-AUC 0.412, recall 90.91%, false alarms 1.31%; Random Forest (A) PR-AUC 0.234, recall 45.45%, false alarms 0.50%; Random Forest (B) PR-AUC 0.320, recall 81.82%, false alarms 0.68%.
With so few clean errors these numbers are unstable. They should not be read as a ranking.

Calibration of the RF-B score: Brier 0.0347 (see `figures/reliability_risk_coverage_calibration.png`).

Most important RF-B features (permutation importance on rel_val):
stability_mean_pred_prob (0.1039), stability_min_pred_prob (0.0685), noise_sigma (0.0318), entropy_norm (0.0224), top3_mass (0.0179).

**Answer to the primary question (measured).** On the test rows, RF-B reached PR-AUC 0.9468 against
0.8483 for the confidence threshold. At the validation-chosen thresholds, it had recall 97.40% and
precision 66.68%, against 95.73% and 57.69% for the baseline.
RF-A (no extra forward passes) reached PR-AUC 0.8857. On clean images alone, the highest PR-AUC came from
**Confidence threshold**, so the Random Forest's advantage comes from the degraded images.

### 8.4 External test (PlantDoc, reported separately)
- **Strict mappings:** 2,234 images, 25 classes. Accuracy 18.04%,
  top-3 38.36%, macro-F1 0.1763.
- **Extended mappings:** 2,572 images. Accuracy 19.52%.
- Excluded: {"unmapped_or_no_match": 0, "unreadable": 0, "identical_to_plantvillage": 0}. Evaluation failures: 0.
- Reliability on PlantDoc (strict): 81.96% of predictions were incorrect.
  - RF-B: recall 79.68%, precision 85.52%, ROC-AUC 0.625, PR-AUC 0.865, flagged 76.37%.
  - RF-A: ROC-AUC 0.667, PR-AUC 0.896.
  - The high PR-AUC mostly reflects the high error rate. A random score would reach about 0.82. The ROC-AUC values show that on field photos the reliability model separates correct from incorrect predictions much less well than on PlantVillage.

## 9. Limitations
- PlantVillage images are lab-style: a single leaf on a plain background. High internal accuracy does not mean field performance;
  see the external PlantDoc results.
- The degradations are synthetic. Real field problems such as occlusion, several leaves, shadows or a different camera are only
  partly represented.
- The Random Forest learns PlantVillage-style errors. Its risk score is a learned score; calibration was measured only on PlantVillage
  test rows.
- Each test image appears under 19 conditions, so the reliability rows are not independent samples.
- There was a single training run with one seed, so no confidence intervals are reported.
- No literature review was performed, so no novelty or superiority over published methods is claimed.

## 10. Future improvements
- Train or fine-tune with field images, and evaluate on more PlantDoc-style data.
- Run repeated seeds and report confidence intervals; add statistical tests between the reliability methods.
- Recalibrate the risk score (isotonic or Platt) on rel_val, and add conformal prediction for coverage guarantees.
- Add segmentation or leaf detection for multi-leaf field photos.
